functions.name: actions_caches
functions.description: Current Actions cache inventory, distinct from artifacts. Cache keys and versions are attributes rather than identities; missing cache IDs fail explicit qualification. Cache inventories can change during pagination and do not represent historic storage usage.

actions_cache_bytes.comment: Sum of returned cache entry sizes; missing sizes stay unknown within observed rows.

functions.name: actions_concurrency_groups
functions.description: Current repository concurrency-group observations identified by repository and group name. Typed group_members describe repository-wide leases or the explicitly selected queue prefix. Group URLs are evidence, not followed directly. last_acquired_at is supplied only by list discovery and remains NULL on direct lookup. Inactive groups are absent from repository inventory and return 404 by name; configured run/group memberships use their own association grain.

actions_concurrency_member_count.comment: Returned queue members, counting leases rather than distinct runs or jobs.

reported_concurrency_member_count.comment: API-reported queue member counters for the selected observations; not inferred from nested rows.

functions.name: workflow_pending_deployments
functions.description: Current workflow-run/environment pairs waiting for deployment protection. This is pending-gate state, not deployment history. No deployment ID is returned or invented. The current-user approval boolean is caller-specific. Missing environment IDs fail identity qualification; parent run/environment navigation is retained without analytical diamonds.

derived_fields.name: wait_started_day
derived_fields.comment: UTC date of the returned wait_timer_started_at instant.

pending_deployment_wait_minutes.comment: Sum of configured wait durations in minutes; not elapsed waiting time.

pending_deployment_reviewer_count.comment: Configured user/team reviewer options, not approvals or all-required reviewers.

approvable_pending_deployment_count.comment: Pending gates the current caller is explicitly allowed to approve.

functions.name: workflow_deployment_reviews
functions.description: Environment-deployment review log occurrences for selected runs. The API supplies no durable review ID or review timestamp; review_ordinal preserves distinct returned occurrences within this retrieval and is not a stable identifier across snapshots. Environment creation/update timestamps describe environments, not review events. Reviewer identity is separate from workflow initiating/triggering actors. Parent run navigation is retained without analytical diamonds.

metrics.name: workflow_deployment_review_count
metrics.comment: Returned review-log occurrences; repeated identical reviews remain distinct.

metrics.name: pending_deployment_review_count
metrics.comment: Review occurrences reporting pending with comments.

reviewed_environment_association_count.comment: Review/environment associations; one review can refer to multiple environments.
